lines.say: A new client costs you five times what an old one does.
You post, you promote, you hand out cards. Meanwhile, forty regulars sit in your phone.
Scroll to the ones who haven't booked in ninety days. They're your cheapest clients.
Text one. Something like, been a minute Dray, got Thursday at six if you want it.
One text, zero ad spend, and the chair's full again.
Comment the word keep and we'll show you who's gone quiet. Message Health dot net.
